mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Molten Shield</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is shielded and reflects damage when attacked.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Annie grants an ally champion @ShieldBlockTotal@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and @MoveSpeedCalc@ Decaying Move Speed for @MovementSpeedDuration@ seconds. While the shield holds, enemies who hit the shielded ally with an Attack or Ability receive @DamageReturn@ magic damage once per shield.

Tibbers always gains the effects of Molten Shield when summoned.

mBuff.mDescription: This unit has increased Move Speed.
<titleLeft>Pyromania</titleLeft><mainText>Every 4 spell casts, the next offensive spell will stun its targets for <font color='#FFFFFF'>@f1@</font> seconds.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
After using 4 Abilities, Annie's next damaging Ability Stuns for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Energized</titleLeft><mainText>Annie's next offensive ability will stun its targets.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Pyromania (@Stack@)</titleLeft><mainText>Annie is charging her spells. Her next spell will stun when she has charged 4 times.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Annie hurls a fireball, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If the target dies, Annie refunds the Mana cost and reduces the Cooldown by 50%.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Annie gains @RPercentPenBuff*100@% Magic Penetration.

Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing @InitialBurstDamage@ magic damage. For the next @TibbersLifetime@ seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for @TibbersAuraDamage@ magic damage per second.

Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Command: Tibbers</titleLeft><mainText>Tibbers is summoned to do Annie's bidding for 45 seconds.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Annie projects a wave of fire, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
